metacleaner

Automated curation of DNA barcode reference databases for metabarcoding and metagenomics

DNA barcode reference databases built from NCBI GenBank (for example with MetaCurator) contain mislabeled sequences. In pollen metabarcoding with plant ITS1/ITS2 databases, this produces reads assigned to fungi, to the wrong plant genus, or to several genera at the same identity.

metacleaner checks each sequence in your database. It removes the sequence if it

  1. matches a database of unwanted sequences (e.g. fungal ITS),
  2. has no match in a database of wanted sequences (e.g. plant ITS), or
  3. matches wanted sequences whose taxonomy disagrees with its own at the rank you choose (genus by default).

Everything runs inside R. The sequence search is built in (C++, multithreaded), so you do not need to install BLAST, Python or command-line tools.

Installation 

install.packages("metacleaner", dependencies = TRUE)   # from CRAN
# development version:
# install.packages("remotes"); remotes::install_github("sbresnahan/metacleaner")

Quick start 

library(metacleaner)

result <- clean_reference(
  query        = "ITS2_database.fasta",   # the database to clean
  reference    = "ITS_plants.fasta",      # sequences you want to keep (e.g. plants)
  contaminants = "ITS_nonplants.fasta",   # sequences you want to remove (e.g. fungi)
  taxonomy     = "ITS2_database.tax",     # or "ncbi" to look taxonomy up online
  level        = "genus",
  threads      = "auto"
)
result                                    # summary
write_results(result, outdir = "cleaned") # cleaned FASTA + taxonomy + report

To try it on the example data shipped with the package:

ex <- function(f) system.file("extdata", f, package = "metacleaner")
clean_reference(ex("query.fasta"), ex("reference.fasta"), ex("contaminants.fasta"),
                taxonomy = ex("taxonomy.tax"))

To build the reference and contaminant databases from NCBI:

build_reference_db('((((ITS1) OR 5.8S) OR 28S) OR ITS2) AND Embryophyta[Organism]',
                   "ITS_plants.fasta")
build_reference_db('((((ITS1) OR 5.8S) OR 28S) OR ITS2) NOT Embryophyta[Organism]',
                   "ITS_nonplants.fasta", dereplicate = TRUE)

Documentation

Full documentation, including all help pages and guides, is on the package website: https://sbresnahan.github.io/metacleaner/.

  • vignette("metacleaner"): step-by-step guide, explanation of the settings and outputs, and how the old command-line options map onto the R arguments.
  • vignette("building-databases"): downloading reference and contaminant databases from NCBI.
  • ?clean_reference, ?classify_queries (exact decision rules) and ?search_sequences (search engine details).

Output

File Contents
<prefix>_clean.fasta kept sequences
<prefix>_clean.tax their taxonomy (taxid,accession,taxid,domain,...,species; or QIIME-style with tax_format = "lineage")
<prefix>_flagged.tsv removed sequences: query taxonomy, the hit that caused removal, its taxonomy, and the reason
<prefix>_summary.txt settings and counts per reason
